model.citation: Wolfram Research, Haversine documentation, sphere-distance definition: https://reference.wolfram.com/language/ref/Haversine.html . Radius 6371000 m is an authored model parameter; no ellipsoidal/geodetic accuracy is claimed.

uncertainty.statement: Authored per-vertex maximum positional displacement in metres under this fixed spherical metric. For n vertices each bounded by u, triangle inequality bounds polyline error by 2(n-1)u. This conditional bound excludes model and geodetic error; it is not statistical coverage.
